(790 minutes) |discs= |cassettes= |pages= |isbn=9780307933560 |timeline=[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]'' |preceded by= |followed by=[[Dark Force Rising (unabridged audiobook)|''Dark Force Rising'' unabridged]] }} '''''Heir to the Empire''''' is the unabridged audio version of the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', released along with the ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]'' reissue, by author [[Timothy Zahn]].
